title: PR 4c — employee profile UI, pay-frequency labels, per-frequency draft pay runs

goals.text: The employee profile (Personal, Pay, Tax, Banking, Super AU / Benefits CA) is linked from the payroll list and edits through the strict PUT: only changed fields are sent, money in cents; AU shows TFN/residency/tax-free threshold/HELP/super fund, CA SIN/TD1/CPP-EI exempt, US SSN/W-4; sensitive inputs start empty with the masked last4 as placeholder and a blank or masked echo is never sent; a 503 pii_key_unconfigured shows the unavailable state, disables the encrypted inputs and re-sends the non-sensitive edit; reveal only on click, re-masks on Hide/30s, never stored; 403 shows owner-only; a deleted (404) employee shows not found. A rate edit reaches the next draft only — an existing draft keeps its stub (pay-runs-drafts-route.test.ts 'a changed rate applies to the NEXT draft only').

Biweekly displays Fortnightly in AU and Bi-weekly in US/CA in en/fr-CA/zh-CN, in core_ui AND the chat reply catalog (agent namespace, used by replyT); frequency is selectable on edit. POST /pay-runs {generate:'drafts'} creates one draft per frequency group from payAnchorDate (fallback startDate): weekly 7d, biweekly 14d, semimonthly 1st-15th/16th-end, monthly calendar, storing payDate and payFrequency; idempotent per group+period; employeeIds scopes it; UTC date-only math (month ends, leap years, past/future anchors, DST). DELETE removes drafts only.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change (4a columns stay). Draft runs created meanwhile carry payDate/payFrequency, which the old code ignores; drafts can be deleted or processed as before. The employee profile page disappears; employee data saved through it stays (the 4b PUT remains).
